# Érudit

> Érudit is a comprehensive open-access digital library for scholarly publishing in social sciences and humanities, featuring journals, books, theses, and research data repositories with advanced search capabilities.

Érudit serves as a major hub for francophone academic research and publishing, offering multilingual access (French and English) to peer-reviewed journals, institutional repositories, and research collections. The platform implements bot-protection security measures including proof-of-work challenges and JavaScript verification to safeguard access to its scholarly content.

## Key Topics

- Scholarly publishing
- Academic journals
- Bot protection
- Proof-of-work

## Core Collections

- [Érudit Homepage](https://www.erudit.org): Main gateway to access journals, books, theses in social sciences and humanities
- [French Homepage](https://www.erudit.org/fr): French-language entry point to Érudit's scholarly collections
- [English Homepage](https://www.erudit.org/en): English-language entry point to Érudit's scholarly collections
- [Journals Collection](https://www.erudit.org/fr/revues): Browse and access peer-reviewed journals in social sciences and humanities
- [Books Collection](https://www.erudit.org/fr/livres): Access scholarly books and monographs from Érudit's catalog
- [Theses Collection](https://www.erudit.org/fr/theses): Browse and search academic theses and dissertations
- [Records & Notices](https://www.erudit.org/fr/notices): Access bibliographic records and metadata for scholarly works

## Research Data & Repository

- [Érudit Document Repository](https://depot.erudit.org): DSpace-powered repository for research data, datasets, and institutional collections

## Search & Discovery

- [Advanced Search](https://www.erudit.org/fr/recherche/avancee): Sophisticated search interface with boolean operators, filters by publication type, date, and subject

## Featured Journals

- [XYZ. La revue de la nouvelle](https://www.erudit.org/fr/revues/xyz): Journal focused on short fiction and literary studies
- [Entrevous](https://www.erudit.org/fr/revues/entrevous): Peer-reviewed journal in social sciences and humanities
- [À bâbord!](https://www.erudit.org/fr/revues/babord): Journal dedicated to critical perspectives in social sciences

## User Access & Authentication

- [User Login](https://www.erudit.org/fr/compte/bienvenue): Account login page for authenticated access to Érudit resources
